integrity: Mathematical proof provided with reproducible independent direct-graph and weighted-quotient checks; no external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only one uniquely marked all-zero corner of the Cartesian power of the three-vertex path is treated. This is an orbit-refinement result, not a claim of graph identification by two-variable counting logic. Arbitrary other markings, longer path factors and prior-publication priority have not been established. Finite verification corroborates, but does not substitute for, the dimension-uniform proof.
title: Exact orbit-refinement wavefronts in marked ternary Cartesian grids
